features.name: Current activity
features.description: Clicking 'Get Current Activity' queries the ActivitySensor and displays the current activity, its confidence, and a timestamp.
expected_behaviour: A 'Get Current Activity' button is visible
Clicking it populates activity/confidence/timestamp output text blocks
A status message updates in the shared status bar

features.name: Activity history
features.description: Clicking 'Get Activity History' reads the activity history and lists count plus first/last activity entries with confidence and timestamps.
expected_behaviour: A 'Get Activity History' button is visible
Clicking it populates a count and history entries
A status message updates in the shared status bar

features.name: Events
features.description: 'ReadingChanged On'/'ReadingChanged Off' subscribe/unsubscribe to the ReadingChanged event and stream live activity/confidence/timestamp output.
expected_behaviour: 'ReadingChanged On' and 'ReadingChanged Off' buttons are visible
Enabling updates activity/confidence/timestamp as readings arrive
Disabling stops updates; status bar reflects state

features.name: Background activity
features.description: 'Register Task'/'Unregister Task' register or remove a background task and show task registration/status, report count, and last reported activity.
expected_behaviour: 'Register Task' and 'Unregister Task' buttons are visible
Unregistering clears it; status bar reflects state
